title: docs(qa): re-point the automation status recipe's start-less flow to what PR #32273 makes it meet
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRtPagDDQG272EKgnkfbMaJ)_

Fixes #32290

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自动化测试清单里那条「无 start 节点」的探针流程，按 PR #32273 之后的真实行为重写：经元数据门保存仍成功，但引擎拒绝注册，读取显示 `registration: refused`，两个触发入口都回 404；经 `POST /api/v1/automation` 保存直接回 400。条目 `automation.trigger-status-contract` 升到 revision 12。
- 为什么改：清单原来期望触发时回 `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE`，#32273 之后没有任何入口能产生这个答复，下一轮测试会报假失败或假缺口。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`，没有产品代码；直接 revert 即可。
- 先看：配方 `qa-flow-status-doors` 第 2 步的 `expect`，再看条目新增的 `acceptance[7]`（保存 400 与读取 refused）和改写后的 `acceptance[0]`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` 应 exit 0；`git grep -n "422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE" -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` 每处要么写明「不可达」，要么写明「出现即失败」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。`FLOW_NO_START_NODE` 这个错误码保留还是退役仍待裁决，本 PR 不做决定。

## What changes (before → after, per place)

All readings are from code at `351c22c9` (current `origin/main` at the base), plus the two #32273 pin files run locally (below). Not re-driven on a live boot.

**Recipe `qa-flow-status-doors`, step 2 (`PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_no_start_node?package=…`)**
- Before: 2xx, then the trigger answers `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE`; "a publish-time check landing makes this step 4xx".
- After: 2xx, stored but never armed. `GET /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_no_start_node` serves the row beside `registration: {state: 'refused', reason}` (reason opens `Flow 'qa_no_start_node' rejected: the flow's top-level nodes hold no start node …`), `GET /api/v1/automation/qa_no_start_node` and both trigger routes answer 404. A read saying `registered`, or a trigger answering 422 or 200, is a finding. A 422 on the PUT itself means #32289's save-door lint rule has landed (it is open at this base), so the step should then be re-read.
- Code: `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts:292` (`validateStartNode`), `:226` (first in `registrationChecks`); `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts:5862`/`:5924` (`syncMutatedFlows` → `recordFlowRefusal`); `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-definitions.ts:244` (refusal stored as `{code?, message}`); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-automation-flow-reads.ts:76` (`resolveFlowRegistrationReader`).
- The recipe's `title`, `why`, `provenance` and `knownGaps[1]` say the same. In the JSON these are cited as `file#symbol`, because the checklist gate refuses `file:line`.

**Item `automation.trigger-status-contract` (revision 11 → 12)**
- `acceptance[0]`: before, five refusal rows including `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE`. After, the four reachable ones (404, 409, 422 `FLOW_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID`, 400) plus 200. `qa_no_start_node` is now on the 404 row, and the 422 `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` row is named unreachable and is not scored. The trigger door probes the registry before dispatch: `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:2912` (`respondToFlowTrigger` → `flowIsUnknown`, `packages/runtime/src/flow-dispatch-status.ts:158`), and the engine holds no start-less flow (`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts:5471` `getFlow`). `flow-dispatch-status.ts:218` still maps the code, so the row exists only on paper. Keep or retire is the open ruling from contract review 6772843445 ③. The item says that, and #32142 stays open. ⛔ No fixture that seeds past registration.
- New `acceptance[7]` and `steps[8]`: `POST /api/v1/automation` with the start-less body answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and keeps nothing (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:3703`, the `POST /` arm → `:2519` `registerAndSaveFlow` → `:2546` `flowDefinitionRefusal`). The metadata read reports `refused`. #32273's dogfood and integration pins are cited as evidence of their own layer only.
- `steps[2]`: `qa_no_start_node` expects `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "Flow 'qa_no_start_node' not found"`.
- `steps[7]`: before, the `/actions` door's 422 row needed an action targeting `qa_no_start_node`. After, only the 400 row needs a scratch action. The 422 row is unreachable there too: `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2676` (`dispatchFlowAction` answers 404 for a flow the engine does not hold).
- `negative[2]` (409 vs 422 collapsed) now uses `FLOW_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID` as its 422 example. Variants: the `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` line says it is unreachable, and a `save · 400 VALIDATION_FAILED` line is added. `source` adds `flow-registration-checks.ts#validateStartNode` and marks the `engine.ts` exit as defensive only.
- `history` row 12 cites #32290, #32273 (merge `1ce6e0f0`), contract review 6772843445 and #32142.

## Why

#32273 moved the start-less refusal from dispatch to registration. The recipe's own text predicted that this step would change (PR #32273 body, "Docs drift", and contract review 6772843445 ③, "confirmed"). The card asks the item to assert what a start-less flow meets now.

## Verification

```
node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs                       -> exit 0 (symbol anchors 1519/1529 resolved, 10 on the named #16898 residual; was 1504/1514)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 \
  src/flow-registration-checks.test.ts src/flow-refused-registration-read.integration.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  17 passed (17)
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands   -> 16 families, each run, each exit 0
dispatch-gates --ran: 16 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED
```

## Out of scope

- `packages/client/src/index.ts` trigger docblocks (and the hand-written docs tables) still promise `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE` at `main`. That is product doc drift (domain:server/client). It is already carried by #32288 / draft PR #32304, so no new card and no edit here.
- Keep-or-retire of `FLOW_NO_START_NODE` in the closed union and the error-code ledger is an open ruling (contract review 6772843445 ③). Not decided here.
